announcements.headline: Director/PDMR Shareholding
announcements.insight: This announcement indicates that a director or person discharging managerial responsibilities has transacted shares in the company. Such dealings are routine governance disclosures and typically have minimal immediate impact on shareholder value unless they signal significant insider sentiment shifts.
